Remark 5.17\group ch05-viscosity-solutions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0114 ↗ hanlin:ch05-lem-5-15 For $u\in S(\lambda ,\Lambda ,f)$, polynomial decay of \[ \mu (t)=|A_t(u,\Omega )\cap Q_1| \] implies $D^2u\in L^p(Q_1)$ for sufficiently small $p>0$, depending only on $n,\lambda ,\Lambda $. Larger exponents require faster decay.
